mypy_errors.note: Set from CI, never from a dev machine: pyproject pins mypy>=1.13 (a floor), so the count moves with whatever a fresh install resolves. Measured twice now — 238 local / 239 CI on 3 Sep 2026, and 148 local / 149 CI on 4 Sep, the second time because CI resolved mypy 2.3.1 against this Mac's 2.3.0. Move it with `gh workflow run ratchet-tighten.yml` and `--adopt`; the local run reports but cannot lower it.

pytest_skip_sites.basis: skipif + bare skip + runtime pytest.skip() across tests/
pytest_skip_sites.note:
25 -> 29 on 23 Sep 2026, deliberately. The framework-codebook audit landed a live harness, and tests/test_codebook_registers.py and tests/test_norman_codebook.py carry two runtime skips each. Both are the house idiom, not new debt. One skips when the configured provider is local: AutoCode needs a cloud provider, so on Ollama the test has nothing to assert. The other is the documented “SKIPPED, NOT PASSED” form for an environmental LLM failure — no credit, rate limit, network, server error — which root CLAUDE.md prescribes so the paid suite degrades honestly rather than erroring, while a genuine BAD_REQUEST still fails. Both sit inside @pytest.mark.slow classes, so CI never reaches either.

24 -> 25 on 20 Sep 2026, deliberately. tests/test_pii_spacy_lazy_fetch.py's test_a_path_delivered_model_redacts_with_no_package_installed runtime-skips when en_core_web_lg is absent. Same class as test_pii_audit's skipif, which this ceiling has always tolerated: a test whose input is a 400 MB model nobody commits, guarded so it says so rather than failing on a fresh clone. It sits inside a @pytest.mark.slow test, so CI never reaches it either way.

23 -> 24 on 12 Sep 2026, deliberately. tests/test_media_time_meta.py's TestAgainstTheCorpus is skipif'd on the format-torture corpus being on disk (IMG_2544.MOV) -- the same class as test_no_fake_success_acceptance's 'input absent: gitignored trial-runs data', which this ceiling has always tolerated: a test whose INPUT cannot be committed, guarded so it says so rather than failing on a fresh clone. Not new debt of a new kind.

Raised because it had stopped being a ratchet and started being a blocker: PR #143 (frontend deps, zero Python files touched, verified green locally) could not auto-merge because it inherited this red from main. A ceiling that holds unrelated correct work hostage is how a gate gets switched off, which is the failure this whole file exists to prevent.

22 -> 23 on 3 Sep 2026, deliberately. The live-LLM AutoCode harness used to ERROR when the Anthropic account ran out of credit, so every local close-out reported 3 errors that were not regressions - noise that trains people to ignore a red summary line, which is the same defect as a skip reading as a pass, only louder. It now skips with a message that leads 'SKIPPED, NOT PASSED', per G2's 'make the skip loud'. This brings it into line with the other two slow files, which already guarded (test_pii_audit skipif, test_no_fake_success_acceptance runtime skip) - it is the third of three, not new debt. A genuine BAD_REQUEST/UNKNOWN still fails.
pytest_skip_sites.why: a skip reads as a pass in every summary line — gaps.md G2

pytest_slow_marked.note:
9 -> 12 on 23 Sep 2026, deliberately. tests/test_norman_codebook.py (2) and tests/test_codebook_registers.py (1) run the authored codebooks against real transcripts through a real provider. That is the only way to check the thing the registers actually claim — that a tag attributed to an author fires on the evidence its witness quote cites — and it costs real LLM calls, so they are slow-marked and excluded from CI by -m “not slow”. The coverage given up is the price of the claim being checkable at all; the register's witness-quote rule is what guards it the rest of the time.

7 -> 9 on 20 Sep 2026, deliberately, and it is why this gate had been red since 13 Sep. Both additions need en_core_web_lg (400 MB), which is why they are slow-marked: test_pii_score_bar's test_a_phone_with_no_context_word_is_redacted_end_to_end pins the measured threshold defect against the real detector, and test_pii_spacy_lazy_fetch's test_a_path_delivered_model_redacts_with_no_package_installed proves the assumption the .dmg and TestFlight deliveries rest on — a model directory with no importable package. Neither can run in CI without a 400 MB download in every matrix cell, so the coverage is given up on purpose. Note the counter also matches prose: of the 9, five are real decorators and four are the marker being explained inside a docstring. Worth knowing before hunting for four tests that do not exist.
pytest_slow_marked.why: excluded from CI by -m 'not slow', so each one is CI coverage given up

swift_english_localizederror.note: Set 21 Sep 2026 at the measured value. The seventh conformer, SidecarResolveError, is classified ENGLISH_BY_DECISION and does not count: its cases are all about _BRISTLENOSE_DEV_* env vars, which a researcher cannot reach. It was also missed by the hand audit that produced the '6 of 6' figure, because that grepped ': LocalizedError' and this one declares ': Error, Equatable, LocalizedError' — the gate found it on its first run. 5 -> 4 on 21 Sep 2026: CopyError moved to LOCALISED (two new keys plus one lifted twin, 42 values). 4 -> 3 the same day: MiroAPI.APIError, two keys, 42 values. 3 -> 0 the same day: the three OAuth enums, 15 shared keys with {{platform}} rather than ~25 per-provider ones, 315 values. ENGLISH_PENDING is now empty — the gate's remaining job is to keep it that way.
swift_english_localizederror.why: LocalizedError.errorDescription is the highest-risk site in this codebase for a sentence filed as data — 6 of 7 conformers rendered English on 21 Sep 2026, every one of them on a surface a researcher reads. Held rather than fixed because each entry is new copy in 21 locales, which is a reviewed act, not a sweep.
